answer: Agents publish a receipt per task, forming one thread each. A daily random walk from 200 honest seeds scores trust: rarely reached identities score below 0.05 and are capped at 5 transactions a day, while a grove of agents trades freely. Escaping needs 20 verified interactions with distinct honest agents, each 30 minutes, so 1,000 Sybils cost 10,000 hours, about $1,000 at $0.10 an hour. Fakes cannot vouch for each other: the walk starts only from honest seeds. Like a nebula where only dense cores become stars, only identities pulled into the honest cluster by real work earn full rights.
